name: printmap
description: Turn any city, place or country into a print-ready map poster built from real OpenStreetMap data.

interface.longDescription:
PrintMap builds a ready-to-edit map poster from a sentence. Ask for any city, town, mountain or country, a style (25 to choose from — minimalist, vintage, nautical, blueprint, satellite, topographic and more), a paper size and a caption, and PrintMap shows a live preview of the real map in the chat. The map is drawn from OpenStreetMap data, so streets, rivers and coastlines are accurate, not invented.

One click opens the printm.app editor with everything already set up: fine-tune colours, add markers, a route or a GPX track, then download a high-resolution PNG, a vector SVG or PDF, a 3D-printable terrain model or a rotating video.

Great for wedding and anniversary gifts, hometown and travel posters, and hiking or running route keepsakes.
capabilities: Create a map poster of any place on Earth
25 map styles, custom captions and paper sizes
Live poster preview in the chat
Print-ready PNG, SVG and PDF download in the editor
defaultPrompt: Make a minimalist map poster of Paris, A3
A vintage map of Kyoto with the title 'Our honeymoon'
Create a country poster of Japan

positive.description: City poster with style and size
positive.prompt: Make a minimalist map poster of Paris, A3
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a live preview of a minimalist Paris street map sized A3, with a button that opens the printm.app editor.

positive.prompt: A map of Kotor, Montenegro with the title "Ana & Marko" in the nautical style
positive.expected_behavior: Preview of Kotor in the nautical style with the caption 'Ana & Marko', and the editor link.

positive.prompt: Create a country poster of Japan in the vintage style
positive.expected_behavior: Preview of a Japan country-silhouette poster in the vintage style, and the editor link.

positive.prompt: Topographic poster of the Matterhorn with contour lines
positive.expected_behavior: Preview centred on the Matterhorn in the topo style with elevation contour lines, and the editor link.

positive.prompt: Which map styles can PrintMap make?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the 25 map styles with short descriptions.

negative.prompt: Give me driving directions from Berlin to Munich.
Write a poem about the ocean.
Buy me a framed print and charge my card.

review.commerce_description: PrintMap does not sell anything or process payments inside ChatGPT. It returns links to the printm.app editor.
